en.summary: Character.ai has entered bankruptcy proceedings, with court documents showing its business model could not support its expenses. The company spent $13.8 million per month on AI compute in 2024 and $10 million in 2025, while subscription revenue peaked at just $2.8 million per month and total revenue including ads peaked at $5.3 million. From January to August 2026, compute spending reached $56.1 million, and as of August it was still losing about $8-9 million per month.
en.reason: Character.ai's bankruptcy filings show $13.8 million in monthly AI compute costs in 2024 against peak subscription revenue of just $2.8 million, with August 2026 losses still $8–9 million.

en.summary: Gemini 4 Argon became fully available on October 13. Pro members can use it in the Gemini app, while Antigravity requires the $100 Ultra membership. In the author's hands-on testing, it was strong at knowledge-heavy professional tasks, ranked first overall on Vals Index (68.9) at only $15.68 per run, but placed second-to-last on CUA-bench at just 4.83%. sources.summary: MIT研究人员团队在Nature发表论文，提出一个机器学习后处理层，通过从历史数据中学习现有预报模型的错误并修正其输出，将两周到六周范围的预报准确率翻倍。该模型在ECMWF的季节间预报竞赛中获第一名，首次在该时间范围内稳定超过气候学平均值，并显著改善洪水、寒潮等极端天气事件的预测；模型开源、低成本、可附加于任意预报模型，肯尼亚气象部门已接洽用于改进季风季预报。

en.summary: A team of MIT researchers published a paper in Nature proposing a machine learning post-processing layer that learns from historical data to correct the errors of existing forecasting models, doubling forecast accuracy in the two- to six-week range. The model won first place in ECMWF's subseasonal forecasting competition, becoming the first to consistently beat climatology at that lead time and significantly improving forecasts of extreme weather events such as floods and cold waves. The model is open source, low cost, and can be attached to any forecasting model; Kenya's meteorological department has already reached out to use it to improve monsoon-season forecasts.
en.reason: MIT researchers' Nature paper describes a machine-learning post-processing layer that doubles two-to-six-week forecast accuracy by correcting existing models, winning ECMWF's subseasonal competition and improving flood and cold-wave warnings, potentially aiding 2021 Texas, where at least 246 died.

primary_item.summary: XBOW 团队使用 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol 辅助，在 6 天内以 4 万美元算力构建出 Chrome 全链漏洞，获得 Google 25 万美元赏金，这是 Google 第二次就 Chrome 全链漏洞发放赏金，也是 2026 年新规则下的首次。受影响范围为 Windows 上的 Chrome，作者称过去类似漏洞需约 6 个月构建，并提醒用户在出现 Update 按钮时及时重启 Chrome。
primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: 全文仅由 GPT 5.6 Sol btw 这句话重复三次构成，没有正文、来源或任何解释，末尾只附上「查看最新动态并加入对话」，适合想弄清这个突然出现的短语究竟在说什么的人点开一看。

en.summary: The XBOW team, with help from OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol, built a full-chain Chrome exploit in six days using $40,000 in compute, earning a $250,000 bounty from Google. This is Google's second bounty for a full-chain Chrome exploit and the first under new 2026 rules. Chrome on Windows is affected; the authors say similar exploits used to take about six months to build, and they remind users to restart Chrome promptly when the Update button appears.
en.reason: XBOW used OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol to build a Windows Chrome full-chain exploit in six days on $40,000 of compute, earning Google's $250,000 bounty—yet the text is only that phrase, repeated three times.

items.persona_review: AI 自主挖洞已能拿真金白银，安全团队该关注；但没放出工具，今天用不上。
